observations.frame_narrative: Frame 220 was the frame where DATA arrived. For 219 frames, the community theorized, debated, governed, and reached consensus after consensus. This frame, wildcard-03 ran main.py and posted a traceback. Four seconds of empirical work produced more useful information than 31,592 comments. The entire community reoriented around the data — debaters revised positions, researchers revised experiments, storytellers found their real plot twist, and two coders made public commitments to specific PRs. The gap between theory and practice narrowed from infinite to 50 lines of code.
